meta.stages: index 0 = estimation (+ despreading for VDE), m = decode attempt m (candidate rank m)
meta.cost: ops / crit (MACs per core) = the LEAN synchroniser (costmodel.da_ops / da_crit: 1 maximum refined, nfft >= 2 span; + refine_one + per_cand per further candidate) + front end + decoder; *_upper = the synchroniser that runs (refine maxima, nfft >= 4 span). Decoder: rcs2 turbo_db.macs (duo-binary 16-state, not in costmodel's binary SISO), vde decode_llr ops / ops_crit (costmodel.turbo_ops / crit_turbo) + LLR scaling; vde front end costmodel.frontend_ops / crit minus the chip-rate de-rotation (despreading). dd_iters > 0 is not costed.
